subject: Fastest air freight quote: STR to EZE
body:
Hi there,

Hope your week's going well. Could you send me an all-in price in EUR for the fastest air freight option from STR to EZE (Buenos Aires, AR)?

The textile samples will be ready on 2026-11-26, and we'll deliver them to Stuttgart airport (STR) ourselves. There are 12 pieces with a gross weight of 1228 kg and a total volume of 5.37 cbm.

Could you also let me know the latest drop-off time at STR and when the shipment would arrive at EZE?

Thanks for checking!

Cheers,
Klaus Weidner
Weidner Spielwaren GmbH, Nuremberg
